job.value: Find a listing and act on it (promote, check insights)

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Manage listings' with a listing table and '141 Active / 32 Inactive / 63 Others' tabs is clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The red 'Switch now' in the CaroUBiz promo strip is the loudest control, more than any listing action.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'View insights' and 'Promote' are clear, but 'Listing quotas' looks like plain text and '63 Others' doesn't say what it holds.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Others' and 'Promotion status' are unexplained, and 'Listing quotas' assumes the seller knows the quota system.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Filters and actions are on the seller's own listings, which they know.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Eight filter controls (Category plus seven chips) and a search bar are all shown above the list before any listing.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: A 'Save 7% just by subscribing to CarouBiz' upsell sits above the page title of a management tool.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Thumbnails, titles and table columns carry it; the only sentence is the promo strip.
